description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: King Ahaziah of Israel is injured and sends to ask Baal-zebub whether he will recover. Elijah says he will die, calls down fire on the soldiers sent to seize him, and Ahaziah dies.
1.sw: Mfalme Ahazia wa Israeli anaumia na kutuma wajumbe kumwuliza Baal-zebubu kama atapona. Eliya anasema atakufa, anashusha moto juu ya askari waliotumwa kumkamata, na Ahazia anakufa.
1.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥ አካዝያስ ተጎድቶ ይድን እንደ ሆነ ብዔልዜቡብን እንዲጠይቁ መልእክተኞችን ይልካል። ኤልያስ እንደሚሞት ይናገራል፤ ሊይዙት በተላኩት ወታደሮች ላይ እሳትን ያወርዳል፤ አካዝያስም ይሞታል።

2.en: Elijah is taken up to heaven in a whirlwind with chariots of fire, and Elisha receives a double portion of his spirit. Elisha makes the water of Jericho wholesome.
2.sw: Eliya anachukuliwa juu mbinguni katika kisulisuli pamoja na gari la moto, na Elisha anapokea sehemu mara mbili ya roho yake. Elisha anayafanya maji ya Yeriko kuwa mazuri.
2.am: ኤልያስ ከእሳት ሰረገላ ጋር በዐውሎ ነፋስ ወደ ሰማይ ይወሰዳል፤ ኤልሳዕም የመንፈሱን ሁለት እጥፍ ድርሻ ይቀበላል። ኤልሳዕ የኢያሪኮን ውኃ ያፈውሳል።

3.en: Joram of Israel, Jehoshaphat of Judah and the king of Edom march against Moab, and Elisha promises water and victory. The king of Moab sacrifices his son on the wall.
3.sw: Yehoramu wa Israeli, Yehoshafati wa Yuda na mfalme wa Edomu wanakwenda kupigana na Moabu, na Elisha anaahidi maji na ushindi. Mfalme wa Moabu anamtoa mwanawe dhabihu juu ya ukuta.
3.am: የእስራኤሉ ኢዮራም፣ የይሁዳው ኢዮሣፍጥና የኤዶም ንጉሥ ሞዓብን ለመውጋት ይዘምታሉ፤ ኤልሳዕም ውኃንና ድልን ተስፋ ይሰጣል። የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ልጁን በቅጥሩ ላይ ይሠዋል።

4.en: Elisha multiplies a widow's oil, promises a son to a woman of Shunem and later raises the boy from death. He makes poisoned stew safe and feeds a hundred men with a little bread.
4.sw: Elisha anaongeza mafuta ya mjane, anamwahidi mwana mwanamke wa Shunemu na baadaye kumfufua kijana huyo kutoka kwa wafu. Anaufanya mchuzi wenye sumu kuwa salama na kuwalisha watu mia moja kwa mkate kidogo.
4.am: ኤልሳዕ የአንዲትን መበለት ዘይት ያበዛል፤ ለአንዲት የሱነም ሴት ልጅ ተስፋ ይሰጣል፤ ኋላም ብላቴናውን ከሞት ያስነሣዋል። የተመረዘውን ወጥ ያነጻል፤ በጥቂት እንጀራም መቶ ሰዎችን ይመግባል።

5.en: Naaman, commander of the army of Aram, is healed of his skin disease by washing in the Jordan as Elisha says. Elisha's servant Gehazi secretly takes payment and is struck with the same disease.
5.sw: Naamani, mkuu wa jeshi la Aramu, anaponywa ugonjwa wake mbaya wa ngozi kwa kuoga katika Yordani kama Elisha anavyosema. Mtumishi wa Elisha Gehazi anachukua malipo kwa siri na kupigwa kwa ugonjwa huo huo.
5.am: የአራም ሠራዊት አለቃ ንዕማን ኤልሳዕ እንደ ነገረው በዮርዳኖስ ታጥቦ ከከባድ የቆዳ በሽታው ይፈወሳል። የኤልሳዕ አገልጋይ ግያዝ በስውር ዋጋ ይቀበላል፤ በዚያው በሽታም ይመታል።

6.en: Elisha makes an axe head float. He leads blinded Aramean troops into Samaria, and during a siege famine grows so severe that mothers eat their children.
6.sw: Elisha anaufanya chuma cha shoka kielee. Anawaongoza askari wa Waaramu waliopofushwa hadi Samaria, na wakati wa kuzingirwa njaa inakuwa kali hata mama wanakula watoto wao.
6.am: ኤልሳዕ የመጥረቢያውን ብረት ያንሳፍፋል። የታወሩትን የአራማውያን ወታደሮች ወደ ሰማርያ ይመራቸዋል፤ ከተማዪቱ በተከበበች ጊዜም እናቶች ልጆቻቸውን እስኪበሉ ድረስ ራቡ ይጸናል።

7.en: Elisha promises food by the next day, and four men with skin disease find the Aramean camp abandoned. The famine ends as he said.
7.sw: Elisha anaahidi chakula kufikia siku inayofuata, na wanaume wanne wenye ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi wanaikuta kambi ya Waaramu imeachwa. Njaa inakoma kama alivyosema.
7.am: ኤልሳዕ በማግሥቱ ምግብ እንደሚገኝ ተስፋ ይሰጣል፤ ከባድ የቆዳ በሽታ ያለባቸው አራት ሰዎችም የአራማውያንን ሰፈር ባዶ ሆኖ ያገኙታል። ራቡም እርሱ እንደ ተናገረው ያበቃል።

8.en: The Shunammite woman's land is restored. Hazael murders Ben-hadad and becomes king of Aram, and Joram and Ahaziah reign in Judah.
8.sw: Nchi ya mwanamke Mshunami inarudishwa kwake. Hazaeli anamuua Ben-hadadi na kuwa mfalme wa Aramu, na Yehoramu na Ahazia wanatawala Yuda.
8.am: የሱነማዊቷ ሴት መሬት ይመለስላታል። አዛሄል ቤንሃዳድን ገድሎ በአራም ላይ ይነግሣል፤ ኢዮራምና አካዝያስም በይሁዳ ይነግሣሉ።

9.en: A young prophet anoints Jehu king of Israel. Jehu kills Joram of Israel and Ahaziah of Judah, and Jezebel is thrown from a window.
9.sw: Nabii kijana anamtia Yehu mafuta kuwa mfalme wa Israeli. Yehu anamuua Yoramu wa Israeli na Ahazia wa Yuda, na Yezebeli anatupwa chini kutoka dirishani.
9.am: አንድ ወጣት ነቢይ ኢዩን በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ አድርጎ ይቀባዋል። ኢዩ የእስራኤሉን ኢዮራምንና የይሁዳውን አካዝያስን ይገድላል፤ ኤልዛቤልም በመስኮት ትወረወራለች።

10.en: Jehu kills the rest of Ahab's house and the prophets and worshipers of Baal. He does not turn from Jeroboam's calves, and Hazael begins to take Israel's land.
10.sw: Yehu anawaua waliobaki wa nyumba ya Ahabu na manabii na waabudu wa Baali. Haachi ndama wa Yeroboamu, na Hazaeli anaanza kuitwaa nchi ya Israeli.
10.am: ኢዩ የቀሩትን የአክዓብ ቤት ሰዎች፣ የበኣልንም ነቢያትና አምላኪዎች ይገድላል። ከኢዮርብዓም ጥጆች ግን አይመለስም፤ አዛሄልም የእስራኤልን ምድር መውሰድ ይጀምራል።

11.en: Athaliah kills the royal family and seizes the throne of Judah, but the infant Joash is hidden in the temple. Seven years later Jehoiada the priest crowns Joash, and Athaliah is killed.
11.sw: Athalia anaiua jamaa ya kifalme na kunyakua kiti cha enzi cha Yuda, lakini mtoto mchanga Yoashi anafichwa hekaluni. Miaka saba baadaye Yehoyada kuhani anamvika Yoashi taji, na Athalia anauawa.
11.am: ጎቶልያ የንጉሣዊውን ቤተ ሰብ ገድላ የይሁዳን ዙፋን ትይዛለች፤ ሕፃኑ ኢዮአስ ግን በቤተ መቅደስ ይሸሸጋል። ከሰባት ዓመት በኋላ ካህኑ ዮዳሄ ኢዮአስን ያነግሠዋል፤ ጎቶልያም ትገደላለች።

12.en: Joash repairs the temple with the people's offerings. When Hazael threatens Jerusalem, Joash pays him off, and Joash is murdered by his servants.
12.sw: Yoashi anarekebisha hekalu kwa matoleo ya watu. Hazaeli anapotishia Yerusalemu, Yoashi anamlipa aondoke, na Yoashi anauawa na watumishi wake.
12.am: ኢዮአስ በሕዝቡ መባ ቤተ መቅደሱን ያድሳል። አዛሄል ኢየሩሳሌምን በዛተ ጊዜ ኢዮአስ ገንዘብ ከፍሎ ይመልሰዋል፤ ኢዮአስም በአገልጋዮቹ ይገደላል።

13.en: Jehoahaz and Jehoash reign in Israel. Elisha, dying, tells Jehoash to strike the ground with arrows, and a dead man touching Elisha's bones comes to life.
13.sw: Yehoahazi na Yehoashi wanatawala Israeli. Elisha, akiwa karibu kufa, anamwambia Yehoashi apige ardhi kwa mishale, na mtu aliyekufa anaigusa mifupa ya Elisha na kufufuka.
13.am: ኢዮአካዝና ኢዮአስ በእስራኤል ይነግሣሉ። ኤልሳዕ ሊሞት ሲቃረብ ኢዮአስን መሬቱን በፍላጻ እንዲመታ ይነግረዋል፤ የኤልሳዕንም ዐፅም የነካ የሞተ ሰው ሕያው ይሆናል።

14.en: Amaziah of Judah defeats Edom and challenges Jehoash of Israel, who defeats him and breaks down Jerusalem's wall. Jeroboam II restores Israel's borders.
14.sw: Amazia wa Yuda anawashinda Edomu na kumpa changamoto Yehoashi wa Israeli, anayemshinda na kubomoa ukuta wa Yerusalemu. Yeroboamu wa Pili anairudisha mipaka ya Israeli.
14.am: የይሁዳው አሜስያስ ኤዶምን ድል ያደርጋል፤ የእስራኤሉንም ኢዮአስ ይገዳደራል፤ እርሱም ድል አድርጎት የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር ያፈርሳል። ዳግማዊ ኢዮርብዓም የእስራኤልን ድንበር ይመልሳል።

15.en: Azariah reigns long in Judah but is struck with skin disease. In Israel king after king is murdered, and Assyria begins to take territory.
15.sw: Azaria anatawala Yuda kwa muda mrefu lakini anapigwa kwa ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi. Huko Israeli mfalme baada ya mfalme anauawa, na Ashuru inaanza kuitwaa nchi.
15.am: ዓዛርያስ በይሁዳ ረጅም ዘመን ይነግሣል፤ ነገር ግን በከባድ የቆዳ በሽታ ይመታል። በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በንጉሥ ላይ ይገደላል፤ አሦርም ግዛት መውሰድ ይጀምራል።

16.en: Ahaz of Judah sacrifices his son, appeals to Assyria for help and copies an Assyrian altar for the temple.
16.sw: Ahazi wa Yuda anamtoa mwanawe dhabihu, anaiomba Ashuru msaada na kuiga madhabahu ya Ashuru kwa ajili ya hekalu.
16.am: የይሁዳው አካዝ ልጁን ይሠዋል፤ ከአሦር ርዳታ ይለምናል፤ ለቤተ መቅደሱም የአሦርን መሠዊያ ይቀዳል።

17.en: Assyria captures Samaria and carries Israel into exile, because they worshiped other gods and would not listen to the prophets. Foreign peoples are settled in Samaria and mix the worship of God with their own gods.
17.sw: Ashuru inauteka Samaria na kuwachukua Israeli uhamishoni, kwa sababu waliabudu miungu mingine na hawakuwasikiliza manabii. Mataifa ya kigeni yanawekwa Samaria na kuchanganya ibada ya Mungu na miungu yao wenyewe.
17.am: ሌሎች አማልክትን ስላመለኩና ነቢያቱን ስላልሰሙ አሦር ሰማርያን ይዞ እስራኤልን ይማርካል። የባዕድ ሕዝቦች በሰማርያ ይሰፍራሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም አምልኮ ከራሳቸው አማልክት ጋር ይቀላቅላሉ።

18.en: Hezekiah trusts God, removes the high places and breaks the bronze snake. Sennacherib of Assyria invades Judah, and his official mocks Hezekiah's trust in God before the walls of Jerusalem.
18.sw: Hezekia anamtumaini Mungu, anaziondoa mahali pa juu na kuivunja nyoka ya shaba. Senakeribu wa Ashuru anaivamia Yuda, na afisa wake anaudhihaki ujasiri wa Hezekia kwa Mungu mbele ya kuta za Yerusalemu.
18.am: ሕዝቅያስ በእግዚአብሔር ይታመናል፤ የኮረብታ መስገጃዎችን ያስወግዳል፤ የነሐሱንም እባብ ያደቅቃል። የአሦሩ ሰናክሬም ይሁዳን ይወርራል፤ ሹሙም በኢየሩሳሌም ቅጥር ፊት ሕዝቅያስ በእግዚአብሔር መታመኑን ያፌዝበታል።

19.en: Hezekiah prays, and Isaiah sends word that Jerusalem will not fall. An angel strikes the Assyrian camp, and Sennacherib returns home and is killed.
19.sw: Hezekia anaomba, na Isaya anatuma habari kwamba Yerusalemu hautaanguka. Malaika anaipiga kambi ya Ashuru, na Senakeribu anarudi nyumbani na kuuawa.
19.am: ሕዝቅያስ ይጸልያል፤ ኢሳይያስም ኢየሩሳሌም እንደማትወድቅ መልእክት ይልካል። አንድ መልአክ የአሦርን ሰፈር ይመታል፤ ሰናክሬምም ወደ አገሩ ተመልሶ ይገደላል።

20.en: Hezekiah falls ill and is given fifteen more years, with the shadow on the steps as a sign. He shows his treasures to envoys from Babylon, and Isaiah foretells that all will be carried off to Babylon.
20.sw: Hezekia anaugua na kupewa miaka kumi na mitano zaidi, kivuli kwenye ngazi kikiwa ishara. Anawaonyesha wajumbe kutoka Babeli hazina zake, na Isaya anatabiri kwamba vyote vitachukuliwa Babeli.
20.am: ሕዝቅያስ ይታመማል፤ በደረጃዎቹ ላይ ያለው ጥላ ምልክት ሆኖ ዐሥራ አምስት ተጨማሪ ዓመት ይሰጠዋል። ከባቢሎን ለመጡ መልእክተኞች ሀብቱን ያሳያቸዋል፤ ኢሳይያስም ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን እንደሚወሰድ ይተነብያል።

21.en: Manasseh rebuilds the high places, worships other gods and sheds much innocent blood, and God declares that Jerusalem will be destroyed. Amon reigns briefly and is murdered.
21.sw: Manase anajenga upya mahali pa juu, anaabudu miungu mingine na kumwaga damu nyingi isiyo na hatia, na Mungu anatangaza kwamba Yerusalemu utaangamizwa. Amoni anatawala kwa muda mfupi na kuuawa.
21.am: ምናሴ የኮረብታ መስገጃዎችን እንደ ገና ይሠራል፤ ሌሎች አማልክትን ያመልካል፤ ብዙ ንጹሕ ደምም ያፈሳል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ኢየሩሳሌም እንደምትጠፋ ያውጃል። አሞን ለጥቂት ጊዜ ይነግሣል፤ ይገደላልም።

22.en: Josiah repairs the temple, and the book of the law is found. Josiah tears his clothes, and the prophet Huldah says judgment will come, but not in his days.
22.sw: Yosia anarekebisha hekalu, na kitabu cha Sheria kinapatikana. Yosia anararua nguo zake, na nabii Hulda anasema hukumu itakuja, lakini si katika siku zake.
22.am: ኢዮስያስ ቤተ መቅደሱን ያድሳል፤ የሕግ መጽሐፍም ይገኛል። ኢዮስያስ ልብሱን ይቀድዳል፤ ነቢይቱ ሕልዳናም ፍርድ እንደሚመጣ፣ ነገር ግን በእርሱ ዘመን እንዳልሆነ ትናገራለች።

23.en: Josiah reads the book of the covenant to the people and renews the covenant. He destroys idols and high places, keeps the Passover, and dies at Megiddo; Egypt and then Babylon dominate Judah.
23.sw: Yosia anawasomea watu kitabu cha agano na kufanya upya agano. Anaziharibu sanamu na mahali pa juu, anaadhimisha Pasaka, na kufa huko Megido; Misri na kisha Babeli zinaitawala Yuda.
23.am: ኢዮስያስ የቃል ኪዳኑን መጽሐፍ ለሕዝቡ ያነብባል፤ ቃል ኪዳኑንም ያድሳል። ጣዖታትንና የኮረብታ መስገጃዎችን ያጠፋል፤ ፋሲካን ያከብራል፤ በመጊዶም ይሞታል፤ ግብፅና ከዚያም ባቢሎን ይሁዳን ይገዛሉ።

24.en: Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon makes Jehoiakim his servant. Jehoiachin surrenders, and the king, the leaders and the temple treasures are taken to Babylon.
24.sw: Nebukadneza wa Babeli anamfanya Yehoyakimu mtumishi wake. Yehoyakini anajisalimisha, na mfalme, viongozi na hazina za hekalu vinachukuliwa Babeli.
24.am: የባቢሎኑ ናቡከደነፆር ኢዮአቄምን አገልጋዩ ያደርገዋል። ዮአኪን እጁን ይሰጣል፤ ንጉሡ፣ መሪዎቹና የቤተ መቅደሱ ሀብት ወደ ባቢሎን ይወሰዳሉ።

25.en: Babylon besieges Jerusalem, breaks through the walls and burns the temple, and Zedekiah is blinded and taken captive. Gedaliah is appointed governor and murdered, and in exile Jehoiachin is released from prison.
25.sw: Babeli inauzingira Yerusalemu, inavunja kuta na kulichoma hekalu, na Sedekia anapofushwa na kuchukuliwa mateka. Gedalia anawekwa kuwa mtawala na kuuawa, na uhamishoni Yehoyakini anaachiliwa kutoka gerezani.
25.am: ባቢሎን ኢየሩሳሌምን ትከብባለች፤ ቅጥሮቹን ጥሳ ቤተ መቅደሱን ታቃጥላለች፤ ሴዴቅያስም ታውሮ ይማረካል። ጎዶልያስ አስተዳዳሪ ሆኖ ይሾማል፤ ይገደላልም፤ በስደትም ዮአኪን ከወህኒ ይፈታል።
